author: NevStarr
body:
Hi,

My username is "Nevstarr". I was caught fly hacking but the reason i did this was because I noticed other members hacking so much and I was very annoyed by this. I really wanted to kill these hackers. I Am a very frequent member on the Avicus network and I really respect the decision to ban a hacker but if I could receive a second chance it would  be my duty to never hack again and help by reporting hackers on avicus and creating a better community for us. I would really appreciate any mod giving me a second chance as I am not the kind of person who repeats such mistakes. I accept it was my fault but I was just very annoyed by the other hacking players. Just 1 more chance would be amazing.

Thanks 
Nevstarr

replies.author: NevStarr
replies.body:
Hi Myworld6,

Does this mean I will be getting unbanned. Because I would really appreciate if that could happen as I will never Ever Repeat my mistake. I am a frequent and loyal player of avicus. This is the server I first ever played so if I could have JUST 1 more chance It would be amazing. I have accepted my mistake completely and I apologize to All of the Avicus Staff and The Whole Avicus Community.

Thanks 
James

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hello, NevStarr,

I understand that you may have been upset by the other players who were hacking, but regardless of your motives for hacking, you still broke the rules on using prohibited clients on the server, which you used to disrupt the enjoyment of other players.

Considering that it has only been one day since the ban, I am sorry but I am forced to deny this appeal. Please appeal in 6-8 months.

If you have any questions or objections to this decision, please leave them below. I will lock this in 24 hours.

Regards, 
Myworld.
